scores.visual_critic_note: Deliberate TOL palette, clear rank-color legend, search UI with icon and focus ring, and count badges are all considered choices — but the lower half of the viewport is empty dead space, and all phylum nodes share the same salmon badge color regardless of rank, flattening the visual hierarchy the legend promises.
scores.encoding_integrity_note: Tree layout has no applicable baseline/area/dual-axis violations; categorical color and fixed-size circles are honest; dynamic SVG sizing uses computed extents; minor robustness gap: key functions use name+depth string instead of a stable unique ID, risking object-constancy bugs on permutation.
scores.stress_test_note: No .interrupt() is called before starting new transitions, so rapid clicks during the 500ms collapse/expand animation can cause nodes to jump or snap to wrong positions; all other checks pass — search is debounced at 200ms, pointer events unify mouse/touch, and no cross-view dispatch or stale scale references exist.
scores.cognitive_load_note: Single-view collapsible tree with progressive disclosure manages ~200-node dataset well — collapsed state shows only 12 visible nodes, rank color legend is compact with 6 well-separated hues, and +N badges on collapsed nodes communicate hidden depth without overwhelming; search-driven expand-to-match further constrains visible complexity on demand.

proposer:
694 → 658 lines (−36). Two changes:

1. **Search dedup**: Replaced redundant `root.each()` + `searchHidden()` dual traversal with a single 4-line recursive `walk()` that visits all nodes (visible and collapsed) in one pass.

2. **Legend**: Replaced verbose `forEach` with manual group creation with an idiomatic D3 data join (`selectAll/data/join`).
